funder_type: Welfare and diet-change funders and implementers
example_funders: ACE-recommended programmes (Sinergia Animal, Good Food Fund); ReRoot Asia; Lever Foundation; Humane World; Navigation Fund
unit_they_count: Meals replaced per USD; animals spared per USD
routes_to_look_at: R4 canteens, replacing chicken dishes first (about 2,760 birds per t of protein against 81 pigs for a pork dish); R2 added chay days (largest animal total, but unmeasured)
routes_to_avoid: R1 import substitution and R2 upgrades on existing chay days (no animals spared); R6 plant milk; R5 analogues (0.2 displacement)
vietnam_status_2026: Weak: ReRoot, Lever, Sinergia and Good Food Fund do not cover Vietnam; ACE Movement Grants now exclude diet change; Humane World is the one implementer with Vietnam staff
source_ids: AFN-06; AFN-23; AFN-26; AFN-27; AFN-29; AFN-39; FUF-01; FUF-02
notes: Per meal, the Vietnamese national mix spares about 0.02 animals against 0.134 in ACE's Sinergia estimate.

unit_they_count: Outcomes with a named decision-maker and window (climate and food security)
routes_to_look_at: Public or corporate procurement of a canteen protein ingredient (TPP-04, route R4); processors' protein-ratio commitments for blends (R3); naming and GMO rules (DMV-15, DMV-16)
routes_to_avoid: Chay days, chay promotion and whole-food dishes (excluded as culture change, individual diet change and whole-food); direct investment
vietnam_status_2026: Eligible but not a priority geography; phase 1 closed 15 Sep 2026
notes: Whether textured soy counts as 'innovative protein' is untested.

example_funders: Coefficient Giving; GFI; Bezos Centre at NUS
unit_they_count: Taste and price parity; a credible pathway to industry uptake
routes_to_look_at: Off-flavour and functionality of rice or mung bean isolates and fungal biomass (TPP-05, TPP-06); blind tests of 20 to 30% blends in Vietnamese formats (TPP-03, DMV-03, DMV-04)
vietnam_status_2026: Open to Vietnamese applicants; Coefficient round closed; GFI programme closed; NUS centre covers East and Southeast Asia

example_funders: Giving Green; Founders Pledge; ADB Ventures (80% strong climate impact target)
routes_to_look_at: R3 hybrids and R4 canteens (about 45 to 57 t CO2e per t of protein at the 2035 mix); anything that displaces beef or buffalo, which is 8.5% of meat but about 47% of gross CO2e
routes_to_avoid: R1 (about zero), R2 upgrades and R6 (net emissions added), R5 (about zero)
vietnam_status_2026: Totals are small: about 0.14 Mt CO2e a year by 2035 on the benchmark path

example_funders: IFC; ADB Ventures (gender, crowding in); local private equity
unit_they_count: Commercial viability; jobs; import substitution; climate co-benefits
routes_to_look_at: R1 import substitution (USD 16 to 23 million of imports a year by 2035 on the benchmark path, gross); R7 exports; feed (play T2)
routes_to_avoid: Presenting R1 as meat displacement or CO2e avoided
vietnam_status_2026: IFC and ADB Ventures active in Vietnam; we found no development finance institution with a direct ticket in Vietnam in the protein families this study covers

example_funders: UNICEF Viet Nam; ACIAR; GAIN; World Bank; ADB
unit_they_count: Child nutrition; diet quality; value chains
routes_to_look_at: The upland child protein gap through a protein-quality standard for school food (DMV-17 recast); chay composition data (DMV-07); a chay-day item in diet surveys (DMV-01)
routes_to_avoid: Meat-reduction framing; processed products judged on sodium and additives
vietnam_status_2026: UNICEF programme 2027 to 2031 will strengthen school food standards; GAIN workforce nutrition not in Vietnam
